entities.name: Mile Dedaković
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mile Dedaković, also known by his nom de guerre Jastreb ("Hawk"), is a retired Croatian Army colonel. Dedaković is best known for commanding the 204th Vukovar Brigade and the city of Vukovar's defenses during the 1991 Battle of Vukovar in the early stages of the Croatian War of Independence.
